name: chat56k
description: chat56k — 23-seat rooms, directory, private chat, BF List. No email, no feed, no algorithm.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.render-build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
